pr_title: fix(main.go): avoid closing the query engine until it is guaranteed to no longer be in use.
pr_body:
partially reverts https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/14064

fixes https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/15232

supersedes https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15533

reusing Engine.Close() outside of tests will require more consideration.

---

See https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15533#discussion_r1893911048 for more details.

Does the crash happen consistently? reproducible?
Could you try with different y versions? 2.52, 2.53(especially this one) and 2.54?

For us, the crash is happening around 1% of the time we trigger shutdown on the server. We haven't seen a way to consistently reproduce it, nor observed a correlation between the crash occurring and any specific actions or state prior to shutdown.

We'll likely try downgrading to 2.53, but it may be some time before we're able to make that change and report any results.
same here, the bug is not consistent and can't reproduce easily.

> Does the crash happen consistently? reproducible? Could you try with different y versions? 2.52, 2.53(especially this one) and 2.54?

No crashes for us after we switched to 2.53.3.

Given that it happens only on shutdown wouldn't the most likely cause be some sort of race introduced by #14064 and/or #14861 ?
At first glance it looks as if query tracker tries to write to mmap-ed file after that file was already closed.

> Given that it happens only on shutdown wouldn't the most likely cause be some sort of race introduced by #14064 and/or #14861 ? At first glance it looks as if query tracker tries to write to mmap-ed file after that file was already closed.

I think I can reproduce it with this test:

```go
func TestActiveQueryTrackerClose(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()

	maxConcurrent := 10
	fileAsBytes, closer, err := getMMapedFile(path.Join(dir, "queries.active"), 1+maxConcurrent*entrySize, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	queryLogger := ActiveQueryTracker{
		maxConcurrent: maxConcurrent,
		mmapedFile:    fileAsBytes,
		closer:        closer,
		logger:        nil,
		getNextIndex:  make(chan int, 4),
	}

	queryLogger.generateIndices(4)
	veryLongString := ""
	queries := []string{
		"TestQuery",
		veryLongString,
		"",
		"SpecialCharQuery{host=\"2132132\", id=123123}",
	}

	want := []string{
		`^{"query":"TestQuery","timestamp_sec":\d+}\x00*,$`,
		`^{"query":"` + trimStringByBytes(veryLongString, entrySize-40) + `","timestamp_sec":\d+}\x00*,$`,
		`^{"query":"","timestamp_sec":\d+}\x00*,$`,
		`^{"query":"SpecialCharQuery{host=\\"2132132\\", id=123123}","timestamp_sec":\d+}\x00*,$`,
	}

	// Check for inserts of queries.
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		start := 1 + i*entrySize
		end := start + entrySize

		queryLogger.Insert(context.Background(), queries[i])

		have := string(fileAsBytes[start:end])
		require.True(t, regexp.MustCompile(want[i]).MatchString(have),
			"Query not written correctly: %s", queries[i])
	}

	// Delete first 2 queries
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		queryLogger.Delete(1 + i*entrySize)
	}

	// Close the query logger
	require.NoError(t, queryLogger.Close())

	// Try to delete last 2 queries
	for i := 2; i < 4; i++ {
		queryLogger.Delete(1 + i*entrySize)
	}
}
```
